name: African Alliance Insurance Plc
source: African Alliance Insurance Plc, statement of comprehensive income for the year ended 31 December 2025 (NGX filing library, Financial_NewsDocs/48053). FIGURES IN NGN, lifted from the N thousand statement and multiplied by 1000. Filed line to panel label: Revenue = Insurance Revenue; Cost of Sales = Insurance service expenses; Gross Profit = Insurance service result from insurance contracts issued, before reinsurance, so Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit in both years; Operating Expenses = Other expenses; Operating Profit (EBIT) = Net insurance and investment result; Net Finance Costs = Net insurance finance expenses; Profit Before Tax, Income Tax and Net Profit as filed. CORRECTION 2026-11-23: the previous version printed Operating Profit (EBIT) of minus 35.76bn and Net Finance Costs of minus 41.28bn for FY2025, neither of which is a filed line (the 41.28bn was the investment income of plus 41,278,818 negated and mislabelled). Both replaced with the filed figures. FY2023 column retained from the earlier collection except those two rows, which are blank rather than carrying a figure that ties to nothing. EPS blank because the filing prints no earnings per share line. FY2024 other operating income is not printed in this condensed statement, so PBT there is 363,001 higher than EBIT less Other expenses. Previous source string: African Alliance Insurance Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, as reported in New Telegraph (9 October 2026) and Punch.
note: Both years are the issuer printed columns in its FY2024 audited statements. Insurance revenue maps to Revenue, Insurance service expenses to Cost of Sales, Insurance service results to Gross Profit, Management expenses to Operating Expenses and Net insurance finance income to Net Finance Costs, per the panel nearest label rule. Income Tax is the difference between printed Profit before taxation and printed Profit for the year and is derived, not printed. EPS is left out because the issuer's per share lines extract blank. Operating Profit (EBIT) is left blank because it cannot be reconciled to the printed Profit before taxation. Previous stored series (FY2019 to FY2015) was withdrawn on this date: its Revenue row repeated the same two values across four of its five periods and no filing could confirm the period labels; the withdrawn copy is kept at static_data/_bak_AFRINSURE_income_20261010_1353.json.
